x-card.description: Collections and objects of Weaviate and Weaviate Cloud: filtered pages, vector, BM25 and hybrid search through GraphQL. Upserts and deletes wait for approval.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Weaviate's REST address with https:// (and its port, 8080 for a server of your own), optionally with a path prefix. Plain http:// only to this computer.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: The collections agents may use; * matches any characters, such as docs_*. Empty: every collection the credentials see. Weaviate's collection names start with a capital letter.

method.title: Authentication
method.description: No authentication only for a server that checks no key, never on prod.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. Prefer a key of a read-only user (AUTHORIZATION_ADMINLIST_READONLY_USERS) or a role that may only read.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: A private CA. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a server whose certificate comes from a private CA.
